reply:
`git stash` by default only stashes tracked changes. Your new file was untracked, so it stayed in the working tree.

Your fix is right: `git stash -u` (or `--include-untracked`) stashes untracked files too. `-a` adds ignored files on top.

My answer conflated behavior. I should have separated: tracked changes are always stashed; untracked and ignored files need flags.
